summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement of the date of its board meeting and third-quarter 2026 earnings release. The board meets November 24, 2026 (Hong Kong time) to approve unaudited Q3 results ended September 30, 2026, with results announced around 6:00 p.m. that day on HKEXnews and an earnings call at 8:00 p.m. No transaction terms, stake, price, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. This is a routine meeting notice and results-calendar filing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
